system.description:
A Wall marksman who learned precision over years watching the Red Waste for movement.

  • Patient Aim: Dead Aim requires only 1 round of aiming instead of 2. The damage bonus remains +2d6 — the advantage is in speed, not raw power.
  • Sentry's Eye: Advantage on checks estimating range, identifying targets at distance, and on all Perception checks during watch duty or a sentry role.
